sv.title: Lågprisfond ska locka globalsparare
sv.summary: Robotrådgivaren Lysa breddar utbudet genom att lansera en globalfond med rekordlåg avgift. Med den börshandlade fonden Global Equity tar Lysa upp fajten med aktörer som Nordnet, Avanza och Montrose. Efter nyår väntas fler aktörer öka utbudet av lågprisfonder.

en.title: Low-cost fund to attract global savers
en.summary: Robo-adviser Lysa broadens its range by launching a global fund with a record-low fee. With the exchange-traded fund Global Equity, Lysa takes on players such as Nordnet, Avanza and Montrose. After New Year, more providers are expected to expand their range of low-cost funds.
